_comment: Shipped default source list — the one git-tracked file in config/ (public board slugs, no PII). Loaded by `ajoa-kit ingest` when the git-ignored config/seed.json is absent; copy + trim into config/seed.json for your own runs. Every `ats`/`feeds` entry is reachability-probed (no-auth tier-1 fetch) and ToS/ToU-vetted. The loader reads ONLY `feeds` + `ats`; `_blocked` (ToS/ToU-excluded) and `_deferred` (ToS-permitting but needs a JSON adapter the kit lacks) are documentation, never loaded.

_blocked._reason: Our widget endpoint is undocumented + apply.workable.com robots.txt ai-train=no (a documented public jobs API exists, but third-party use is a grey zone with no explicit permission). Only ATS where HF resolves.
Public /api/offers is unauthenticated, but the separate API-Terms PDF (v2022.1.0) targets integration partners and could not be fully verified — exclude until reviewed.
Aggregator: 403 to automated fetchers + robots.txt ai-train=no, blocks AI crawlers; ToS inaccessible — exclude.
User Agreement bars scraping/automation + redistribution; robots.txt blocks job paths — paste only, never ingested.
Publisher API deprecated (301 to partners), RSS 404; ToS + robots.txt (/jobs, /api) bar automation — paste only.
No public read API (api.stepstone.com is inbound-only); ToS bars scraping; robots.txt disallows /public-api + parameterized URLs — paste only.
No public API/RSS (JobCloud); ToS bars crawlers/scrapers/automation; robots.txt disallows /api + detail pages — paste only.

_deferred._note: Public JSON aggregators — usable only after a JSON-feed adapter exists (the kit ships only an RSS adapter + the 6 ATS adapters) AND each source's condition below is met. Tracked as a follow-up issue.

sources.name: arbeitnow
sources._tos: requires a backlink to arbeitnow.com; broad commercial-use clause ambiguous for derived analytics

sources.name: jobicy
sources._tos: commercial use needs Jobicy approval; robots ai-train=yes (permissive)

sources.name: himalayas
sources._tos: commercial use needs authorization; verify himalayas.app/docs API terms

sources.name: remotive
sources._tos: free API is traffic-back-only; keyword-trend use likely needs the paid tier (~$5k/mo); max 4 req/day; attribution required
